properties.name: platform.cache.stores.*.enabled
properties.description: Enables a logical platform cache store.

properties.name: platform.cache.stores.*.provider
properties.description: Provider used by a logical store.

properties.name: platform.cache.stores.*.connection-factory-bean
properties.description: Optional RedisConnectionFactory bean for an additional logical Redis store. The default store uses Boot's redisConnectionFactory.

properties.name: platform.cache.caches.*.fallback.local-store
properties.description: Local logical store used during primary-store degradation.

properties.name: platform.cache.caches.*.ttl-jitter.percentage
properties.description: Platform TTL randomization percentage used to reduce synchronized expiry.
